findings.current: The Kongtong Sect must have had enough time to prepare, and enough strength to defend itself.
findings.defect: The Korean says the sect’s prior defenses/preparations and its strength must have been sufficient. It does not say the sect had enough time to prepare.
findings.rationale: 사전의 방비도, 전력도 충분했을 텐데 refers to the adequacy of prior defenses and military strength, not to having sufficient time.
findings.replacement: The Kongtong Sect must have had sufficient defenses in place beforehand, and enough strength.

findings.current: even knowing that he was beyond reason
findings.defect: This characterizes the man as irrational. The Korean instead says the speaker knew he was someone with whom words would not work.
findings.rationale: 말이 통하지 않을 상대 describes someone one cannot communicate with or persuade; “beyond reason” shifts the emphasis to the person’s rationality.
findings.replacement: even knowing there was no getting through to him

summary: Two minor fidelity issues: an added implication about preparation time and a shifted sense of the attacker’s unreasonableness.
